# All 40 reasoning problems — review copy

Pool: reasoning-v2-levels. Generator: reasoning-v1. Seed: 20260911.

These are the exact current puzzle inputs, in pool order. Solutions are omitted. Levels are operator labels, not shown to agents. Agents have no code-execution tool; they can test up to 100 candidate answers per step.

Levels 1–4 target accessible work; 5–8 target harder work. Only the five level-1 instances have been calibrated live.

## Reading the inputs

- Clique: ADJ i is the connection row for vertex i. A 1 in position j means vertices i and j are connected. Select exactly K vertices, every pair connected.
- Subset sum: NUMS i gives number i. Select distinct indices whose values sum exactly to TOTAL. Not every number needs to be used.
- SAT: select true or false for each variable. Each three-number clause is an OR; negative numbers negate that variable. Every clause must hold. For example, 1 -2 3 means x1 OR NOT x2 OR x3.
- Set balancing: SETS i is a membership bit vector; a 1 includes that element. Assign +1 or -1 to every element. Every set sum must lie between -BOUND and +BOUND.
- Progression-free colouring: assign colour 0 or 1 to each integer from 1 to N. No four equally spaced integers may all have the same colour, for any positive spacing.
